the DU mockup with FCs containing both 1 g and a 100 mg of enriched uranium were tested under intensive neutron and photon radiation at the research reactor IRT MEPhi and VVR-c, and the results of the tests were in agreement with the expected behavior of the FCs.

the development of the DU mockups for the IETR neutron diagnostic.
the FC detector unit testing under intensive neutron and γ-radiation.
the development and testing of the FC detector unit, which is designed for monitoring of the neutron flux in the International Experimental Ther­monuclear Reactor divertor.

the FC detector unit has passed all the tests successfully and is ready for the ITER project.
the DU mockup is a reliable neutron diagnostic device.
the DU with FC is a suitable neutron flux monitor for fusion reactors.

the DU mockup was successfully tested under intensive neutron and γ-radiation conditions.
